fields.description: Zero-padded "{fiscal_year}-{accounting_period}" (e.g. "2026-06"), computed in Python (erp_actuals_data.py's before_insert) and used as this doctype's own autoname source - a plain format-autoname on the raw accounting_period field would NOT zero-pad it, which would sort "2026-10" before "2026-2" in list views/exports; this field exists purely to make that sort correct.
fields.label: Period Key

fields.description: The ERP's own fiscal_year value (e.g. 2026) - NOT this app's "2026-27" financial-year string used elsewhere. One record exists per (fiscal_year, accounting_period) combination, ever - this doctype holds the Foundation's full actuals history from whenever backfill first ran, not just a handful of fixed periods.
fields.label: Fiscal Year

fields.description: The ERP's own accounting_period value (1-12, April-start: 1=April ... 12=March).
fields.label: Accounting Period

fields.description: Human-readable month + financial year, e.g. "June 2026-27" - computed at save time purely for readability in list views/reports; fiscal_year/accounting_period above remain the real identifying fields.
fields.label: Period

fields.description: Why this period was originally fetched/backfilled (e.g. "Current year, current month", "Previous year, accounting period 12 (March)", "Current year backfill - period 3 of current FY") - purely for human context when reviewing this list; has no effect on refresh behavior, since the scheduled job refreshes every record here regardless of why it was first created.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The full raw actuals API response for this period ({status, fiscal_year, accounting_period, count, data}), gzip-compressed and then encrypted with this site's own encryption_key (budget_mis.api.erp_actuals_data._encode_response/_decode_response) - never stored as plain JSON or plain base64. A plain-JSON response for one period is large enough (~6MB observed) to risk MySQL's max_allowed_packet on save, and the real org financial figures in it should not be readable by anyone with only DB/Desk access to this record. Reports call get_actuals_data() to read+decode this - there is no live-ERP fallback and no Redis cache layer for this path; a period with no successful fetch yet simply has no data to serve. Overwritten whole on every refresh; this doctype keeps no row-level history, only each period's single latest response.
fields.label: Response JSON
